invariants.rationale: The context should be provided to perform restore actions.
The restoreInstantTimestamp should be non-null as it indicates the instant to restore.
No restriction is given on savepointToRestoreTimestamp, it can be null or non-null.
Restore instant timestamp is generally non-empty string to represent a valid timestamp.
If savepointToRestoreTimestamp is provided, it is expected to be non-empty string.
